children: Data#3's better-than-expected sales trading update isn't enough to turn Morgans analyst Nick Harris bullish on the Australian tech-services provider. With an unchanged hold rating, Harris tells clients in a note the stock is more than fairly valued in the absence of any outlook upgrade. Gross sales and earnings have been tracking ahead of management's December-half expectations, but Harris points out this is down to some one-off transactions, favorable year-earlier comparisons, and strong trading conditions. The June half is expected to be more sober, he adds. Morgans raises its target price 21% to 13.40 Australian dollars. Shares are up 2.7% at A$13.83. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
